SETTING 
STANDARDS
Starship-inspired design reflects XPENG’s vision to not only push the 
boundaries of innovation, but commitment to blending technological 
sophistication with modern aesthetics.
 
The bold robotic face is framed by the full-width integrated light bar for a 
futuristic presence, plus the fastback silhouette with long front overhang, 
short rear overhand, and clean side sculpting delivers 
coupe-like dynamism.
3

ALL WHEEL 
DRIVE (AWD) 
PERFORMANCE 
New for 2026, the AWD Performance variant comes with all Long Range 
features but with improved performance, accelerating from 0-62mph in 
just 4.13 seconds. 
AWD Performance is available exclusively in Black Edition styling, 
featuring Black 20” alloys and Smoked Grey Badging.
4

EXTERIOR DESIGN
Starship-inspired design reflects XPENG’s vision to not only push the 
boundaries of innovation, but commitment to blending technological 
sophistication with modern aesthetics.
The bold robotic face is framed by the full-width integrated light bar for a 
futuristic presence, plus the fastback silhouette with long front overhang, 
short rear overhand, and clean side sculpting delivers 
coupe-like dynamism.

SUSPENDED ROOF
The suspended roof enhances the car’s dynamic, 
forward-thinking stance while allowing for a more 
spacious, airy feel inside. It provides exceptional 
headroom for both front and rear passengers, 
merging stylish sophistication with practicality for 
a more comfortable and open driving experience. 
FRAMELESS DOOR & HIDDEN DOOR HANDLE
Frameless doors eliminate obstructions, offering 
a  clearer  view  and  reducing  blind  spots  near  
the  A-pillar,  so  you  can  enjoy  a  more  open,  
unobstructed driving experience. 
LED SPOILER
Aerodynamic spoiler with suspended light bar enhances both form and airflow 
control.

futuristic, immersive space.

*AWD Performance model only

8

EXCELLENCE
DEFINING FEATURES
XPENG is driven by a commitment to smart mobility, seamlessly blending advanced 
technology with everyday usability. The G6 is built to enhance every journey 
through intelligent systems engineered for precision, comfort and connectivity,
01
02
03
XPILOT ASSIST*
Powered by an Intelligent driving chip single Orin, XPILOT ASSIST 
enhances driving, parking and safety. Benefit from Adaptive Cruise 
Control, Adaptive Turning Cruise and Auto Lane Change; Enhanced 
Automatic Parking Assistance with remote parking for difficult spaces, 
360 degree camera with transparent chassis; plus, forward, side and rear 
collision prevention.
Over-the-air (OTA) software updates
Your new car keeps getting smarter, with continuous over the air updates 
designed to improve both your driving experience and efficiency of the 
vehicles.
XPENG App
Remote control your G6 from the XPENG App, with forward and reverse 
vehicle summoning. Plus handy convenience features such as remote 
lock/unlock, climate control, ability to sound the horn and flash lights and 
monitor and schedule charging status .
Full-Stack Lofic Architecture
Equipped with a front binocular camera and rearview camera, the XPENG 
Full-Stack Lofic Architecture enhances environmental perception across a 
wide range of driving scenarios, adapting seamlessly to both light and dark 
conditions. All while acting as a dashcam for added security.
04
Industry-Leading Sensor Suite
Visual perception range extended by 125% compared to the previous 
generation, with the ability to recognise and distinguish 49 types of 
obstacles—both dynamic and static—with precision. 
05
Pet Mode
Keep your furry friends safe and comfortable while you’re away from 
your vehicle. With a message displayed on the centre console to inform 
passersby’s that they’re being taken care of.
06
Seamless Entry
Using the UWB ultra-wideband smart remote control key, NFC card Key or 
Automatic Mobile Phone unlocking.
07
9
*Features and equipment may vary depending on vehicle specification. 

BATTERY AND POWERTRAIN 
Feature advanced lithium-ion phosphate battery systems that 
ensure efficiency, longevity, and power. The batteries are optimized 
for maximum energy density and performance with triple-layer 
battery shield, 4-3-4 design which enhances resistance to impact, 
fire and thermal runaway.
The G6’s powerful electric motor provides smooth acceleration and 
responsive handling, available in rear-wheel drive (RWD) in Standard 
Range and Long Range or all-wheel drive (AWD) Performance.
ELECTRIC EFFICIENCY 
Regenerative Braking: The G6 features regenerative braking, which 
helps recover energy during braking, improving overall efficiency 
and extending the vehicle’s range.
Zero Emissions: As a fully electric vehicle, the G6 produces no 
tailpipe emissions, contributing to a cleaner environment.
08
09
10
SUSPENSION
Front Double-Wishbone & Rear Five Link Independent Suspension 
Setup Controls full directional movement of each individual wheel 
for a smooth ride and agile handling with reduced road vibration.
10-80% RAPID CHARGE IN 12 MINU
TES
Max 451kW charging capacity. XPENG G6 is not just built for today’s 
generation of chargers, but the next. 5C Supercharging Battery 
developed on Full-Domain 800V High Voltage SiC Platform, with 
advanced XHP 3.0 thermal Management. 
10
11

Full-Car Voice Activation: Fast, multi-zone voice control across cockpit functions 
— even from the rear seats.
Adaptive Scene Intelligence: Supports customisable in-car scene modes with 
continuous OTA updates that evolve with your preferences.
9 inch, full view streaming media rearview mirror: available in Long Range and 
Performance.
Built in Dashcam*: The vehicles parking and sentry cameras act as a dashcam.
11
SMART CABIN 
EXPERIENCE
*
Long Range and Performance models only 

18-SPEAKER XOPERA
SOUND SYSTEM
All 18 speakers (including 2 driver seat stereos) are equipped with the Xopera sound 
system, which has been masterfully tuned, 7.1.4 panoramic effective technology, 
and self-developed acoustic algorithms to create mind-blowing sound effects.
Three-layer composite paper cone speakers
- “Sandwich” structure, paper + EPP + paper, the upper layer of high-end
materials has beautiful appearance and texture; the middle layer of EPP 
material is lightweight, good damping; the bottom layer of composite pulp 
has a high degree of rigidity, solid support.
- Effectively ensure that the bass is elastic, deeper and more infectious
sound.
01
KEVLAR diaphragm speaker
- Bulletproof fiber material, outstanding transient response; tone is more
fluid, natural, and layered. Ideal for fast-paced songs with rapid and frequent 
changes in tone and volume.
02
Titanium membrane speaker
- Fine and transparent treble, good metallic performance, clear tone,
especially in the appreciation of symphonic music and pop tunes, the effect 
is better.
03
Spatial sound 2.0, building the cockpit surround sound effect
- Based on the theory of psychoacoustic binaural localization of the sound
source, the position and orientation of each speaker are optimized to broaden 
the sound’s width.
- Each occupant of the vehicle can feel the “emperor position” of listening
delight thanks to the 7.1.4 panoramic sound effect technology, which 
increases the degree of music extension and thus the sound field.
04
Lossless restoration algorithms for the highest possible quality of any type 
of music
- Repairing lossy music with the player’s low bit rate to achieve lossless-like
sound quality, which can improve the sound quality of digitally compressed 
audio.
- The vehicle reproduces the original sound by compensating the sound field
and recovering the high-frequency sound, allowing every type of regular 
music to be delivered in flawlessincreases the degree of music extension 
and thus the sound field.
05
Vocal beautification algorithms, as if you were listening live
• Improved some of the vocal overtones for a more genuine and intimate
sound signature.
• A more immersive vocal image and richer vocal expression without
distorting the sound.
06

12 - way power adjustable
driver seat 
Featuring industry-leading intelligent comfort 
configurations, including 8-way power adjustment 
+ 4-way lumbar support, multi-directional t
ensile
surfaces to fit ergonomic curves. Enjoy heated 
and ventilated seats as standard, Long Range and 
Performance come with massage functions.
6- way power adjustable
passenger seat 
Treat your driving companions to ultimate comfort 
with heated and ventilated seats as standard, plus 
massage functions available in Long Range and 
Performance.
12 - position backrest adjustable
rear seat 
Comes with the ability to tilt and recline, the backrest 
can be adjusted from 27° to 38.4°, offering 12 manual 
adjustment options. Whether you’re seating family or 
friends, the rear seats can be tailored to provide the ideal 
position for relaxation, with the flexibility to lie back or sit 
upright for maximum enjoyment.

14

571L (1374L with rear seats folded) rear trunk + center 
console with underfloor stowage for everyday utility.

Steering Wheel Functions
Four-way adjustable heated leather steering 
wheel as standard.
Quickly access frequently used features including 
auto-parking and cruise control from the 
customisable button on the steering wheel.
The scroll control on the left spoke enables raising 
or lowering the temperature, and engages the 
air-con automatically if off. You can also control 
air flow without touching the screen.
Navigate back from Apple CarPlay or Android 
Auto to the XPENG dashboard with the back 
button, as well as activating voice control and 
controlling volume.

DIGITAL SCREENS
Boasting a 15.6 inch, floating design central control screen 
and 10.25 inch digital dashboard.

Vehicle
5-Year / 75,000
Mile Warranty
Drive confidently knowing you’re backed by a robust manufacturer 
warranty that covers your vehicle for five years or up to 75,000 miles - 
whichever comes first. It’s our promise of quality and reliability. 
Battery
8-Year / 100,000
Mile Warranty
Hit the road with confidence, knowing your battery is protected by an 
eight-year or 100,000-mile warranty - whichever comes first. This 
coverage reflects our commitment to advanced technology, long-term 
performance, and the dependable quality you expect from XPENG.
Body
12-Year / Unlimited
Mileage Warranty
Our 12-year, unlimited mileage anti-corrosion warranty protects against 
corrosion and perforation, ensuring long-term durability. It’s part of our 
commitment to quality and reliability - so you can focus on the road 
ahead, not what’s under the surface.
Service Intervals
1-Year / 12,500
Miles
Keep your XPENG performing at its peak with routine servicing 
recommended every 12,500 miles or one year - whichever comes first. 
Regular maintenance helps ensure long-lasting reliability and the smooth, 
worry-free driving experience you expect.

At XPENG UK, we’re committed to giving you the best possible experience. Here’s what we promise: 
• Friendly, helpful service from people who care.
• We’ll listen to you carefully and do everything we can to make things right.
• We’ll always treat you with fairness and respect.
• We’ll keep things simple and clear—no jargon, just honest info.
• We’ll try to answer your questions the first time, or let you know when to expect an update.
XPENG UK: Discover the Xtras that go the extra mile
